item.text: Existing tests check that image fields are cleared but do not check disk contents. I also found a naming mismatch that affects cleanup: current user uploads include a timestamp in the filename, while account deletion looks for fixed filenames.

/bin/bash -lc "cat > .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'
Progress: Fault localization complete. No project source or tests modified.
Findings:
- src/groups/cover.js removeCover deletes DB fields only. Full and thumbnail URLs are separate local uploads under files; resolve only validated local URL prefixes to upload_path/files.
- src/user/picture.js removeCoverPicture deletes DB fields only; removeProfileImage and getLocalCoverPath/getLocalAvatarPath are absent. Existing deleteCurrentPicture handles replacement only, checks hard-coded /assets/uploads/profile/, and removes just the referenced filename.
- src/socket.io/user/picture.js removeUploadedPicture builds a base_dir/public path, does not await file.delete, and duplicates DB cleanup. src/socket.io/user/profile.js passes a data object to removeCoverPicture and has no explicit invalid-data guard for null/invalid uid.
- src/user/delete.js deleteImages searches fixed uid-profilecover.ext and uid-profileavatar.ext names, while current uploads use uid-profilecover-TIMESTAMP.ext and uid-profileavatar-TIMESTAMP.ext. Its allowed extension list can vary with plugins.
- Existing tests in test/user.js and test/groups.js assert field removal only; no disk-removal assertions found. Group getGroupFields and user getUserFields can transform stored URLs with relative_path/defaults, so raw DB URL fields are preferable for safe path validation.
Uncertainty: Interface filename pattern omits timestamps, unlike current writers. Cleanup should cover both legacy fixed names and current timestamped names if all associated images must be removed.
EOF
git status --short"

item.text:
I traced the cleanup failures but did not edit project source or tests because this run is restricted to fault localization.

- [src/groups/cover.js](/app/src/groups/cover.js:64): `Groups.removeCover` clears the three database fields but never deletes the full size cover or thumbnail.
- [src/user/picture.js](/app/src/user/picture.js:204): `User.removeCoverPicture` clears fields only. `removeProfileImage`, `getLocalCoverPath`, and `getLocalAvatarPath` are absent.
- [src/socket.io/user/picture.js](/app/src/socket.io/user/picture.js:47): avatar removal duplicates the field logic and does not await `file.delete`. [src/socket.io/user/profile.js](/app/src/socket.io/user/profile.js:41) needs explicit invalid UID handling and delegation to the user image layer.
- [src/user/delete.js](/app/src/user/delete.js:219): account cleanup searches for fixed filenames, but current uploads use timestamped filenames such as `uid-profileavatar-TIMESTAMP.png`.

The fix needs to validate local upload URL prefixes before mapping them into `upload_path`, remove every associated supported image variant, tolerate missing files, clear the specified fields, and preserve the socket action hooks. The stated filename pattern omits timestamps; the current upload writers include them, so cleanup must account for both. Existing tests assert database changes but do not verify that files were removed.
